Diagnosis.Evidence: Measured live with a temporary probe spec (deleted after the run; screenshots preserved at the change Evidence step): menu container 150px wide, content box 134px after the li 0 8px padding. In ru, «Вставить строку выше», «Вставить строку ниже», «Вставить столбец слева» and «Вставить столбец справа» each wrap to two lines (Range.getClientRects().length == 2; li scrollHeight 50 vs clientHeight 25). Because li has no overflow control and the ul stacks fixed-height items, each wrapped second line is painted exactly over the next item's first line — the reported «накладки». «Удалить строку/столбец» and all en labels fit on one line at 13px, which is why the defect is invisible in en and CJK locales. The CSS is unchanged since the B1 muya v1.2.3 import (day-one geometry); the ru UI exposed it.

C-TABLE-BAR-MENU-OVERLAP.FixRationale: white-space: nowrap on li.item plus a content-driven menu width (width: max-content with min-width: 150px) is the smallest change that guarantees the Goal in every locale, including future ones: the menu can never wrap again, and the 150px floor keeps the en geometry identical. This mirrors the established muya pattern — blockViewer rows already combine white-space: nowrap with width: max-content, and BaseFloat's element-resize-detector re-measures the container and calls popper.update() when it grows, so positioning adapts with zero JS changes. Note .ag-table-bar-tools is applied to both the floatBox wrapper and the inner container; the wrapper's inline width set by the resize detector wins, so the class-level width only bootstraps the container measurement.

Alternatives.Alternative: Still breaks for the longest shipped labels (fr «Insérer une colonne à droite», es «Insertar columna a la izquierda») and every future locale; wasteful whitespace in en/CJK.

Keeps 150px but lets items grow downward. Produces two-line menu rows (unusual for a context menu), breaks the remove-divider geometry designed against 25px items, and needs the same resize-detector height pass anyway.
Locale strings are correct as written; mutating copy to fit a layout bug inverts the dependency.

Risks.Risk: WebKit (the engine the macOS build ships) text metrics differ from Chromium's; mitigated by routing the new spec through the webkit-tables project, which exists precisely because table UI is engine-sensitive.

Sibling muya float menus (frontMenu 190px, imageToolbar) may carry the same fixed-height wrap trap for long locales; the plan measures them as evidence, and any real finding becomes a follow-up change (per Constraints), not a scope creep here.
